label: Uneasy calm
summary: Spain mourned at least 68 people killed when two high-speed trains collided near Toledo. A Russian strike set buildings ablaze in Kharkiv, fighting in Ethiopia drove tens of thousands into Kenya, and the Iran war ground on as Tehran pressed a Hormuz plan and Washington denied peace talks. Brazil's defeated candidate Flavio Bolsonaro declared himself the rightful leader after flying to the US. Cyclone Arnab killed at least three in southern India, and the US rolled back methane rules. Canada's central bank raised rates for the first time in three years. There was relief too: staff at the DR Congo treatment centre where the Ebola outbreak began celebrated their last patient going home, a fisherman was rescued after 41 days adrift off Kiribati, and research advances covered EV batteries and microplastic filtering. The weighted formula gave 41; no editorial adjustment.
